mcp_tool_configuration.title: MCP Tool Configuration Required
mcp_tool_configuration.message:
Some alternative AI providers don't fully support deferred tool loading (tool search).

To fix this:
1. Open Settings ({{shortcut}})
2. Go to "Claude Code" panel
3. In the "Environment Variables" section, add:
   ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH = false
4. Save and retry your request

figma_mcp.title: Figma MCP server needs reconfiguration
figma_mcp.message:
Your current Figma MCP configuration will not work in Nimbalyst. Figma does not allow OAuth-based MCP in certain apps.

To fix it, open MCP settings and follow these steps:

1. Remove the existing OAuth Figma MCP configuration.
2. Add a new Figma MCP configuration from the Nimbalyst MCP template.
3. Add your Personal Access Token to the MCP configuration.
